title: 5,730 job opportunities bring hope to 601 jobseekers in Santiago City

blocks.text: A total of 5,730 local and overseas job vacancies were made available to 601 jobseekers during the first Serbisyong Pang-Trabaho: Employment and Livelihood Caravan in Santiago City, Isabela, on November 6, providing employment opportunities amid the country’s rising unemployment rate. The initiative comes as the Philippine Statistics Authority’s Labor Force Survey reported 2.86 million unemployed Filipinos in September 2026, equivalent to an unemployment rate of 5.4 percent. This was higher than the 2.77 million unemployed recorded in August 2026 and the 1.96 million in September 2025.
